_note: USD per million tokens. A model is priced by the longest key that appears in its deployment name (lower-cased). GPT-6 numbers are UNVERIFIED third-party reports: replace them from the Azure pricing page (Foundry > Models > the model > Pricing) before trusting budget caps. cache_read / cache_write are multipliers on the input rate. Unknown models fall back to 'default' (deliberately the most expensive GPT-6 rate, so a budget cap trips early rather than late).
